text:
How Google Ads works for a local business.

Someone in Joondalup types "emergency plumber" at 7am.
Your ad shows at the top.
They tap your ad. You pay for that tap.
They scroll past? You pay nothing.

You only pay when someone looking for your service clicks.

Picture a sparky in Cannington running Google Ads.

People tap his ad and land on his homepage. His phone number is at the very bottom.

Plenty never scroll that far.

Add a call asset. It puts a call button on the ad itself, so people ring you straight from Google.

Electrician in Morley wants top 3 on Google for "electrician Perth".

So do a few hundred other sparkies. A year of work. (Bring snacks.)

"Electrician Morley" is different. His van lives there. Most of those sparkies are too far away to count.

Start with your own suburb.
